name: wordmarkReveal
title: Wordmark Reveal
description: Minimal brand stamp — wordmark or logo with URL and action. Compose for a quiet closer when the video already has motion.

brandName.description: Brand name — rendered as wordmark when no logoUrl is set

url.description: Optional URL shown below — falls back to `cta` if empty

cta.description: Fallback CTA text shown when url is empty

logoUrl.description: Optional logo image URL — when set, replaces the wordmark
